title: Thermal preload + galling + service cycles

thermal_screen.interpretation: metal CTE mismatch is secondary but not zero; real joint stiffness reduces this simple upper bound. Elastomer force/compression set remains the more uncertain temperature effect.

galling_strategy.rule: dry stainless-on-stainless torque-controlled assembly is not release baseline
galling_strategy.preferred_process: controlled qualified lubricant/finish on external J2 M2.5 screw threads and under-head bearing surface; contamination compatibility reviewed because this is an instrument
galling_strategy.qualification: same cleaning, finish/lubricant and bearing treatment used in torque-preload calibration and production
galling_strategy.source_basis: NASA fastener guidance documents galling/scatter risk and recommends specified lubrication where possible

candidates: preload-only with service witness mark if vibration qualification passes
qualified removable thread-locking compound if compatible
mechanical locking only if it does not compromise service/space
locking_strategy.reject: unqualified liquid threadlocker or random anti-seize because it changes nut factor and service chemistry

service_qualification.cycle: disassemble → inspect → clean/process → new O-ring → reassemble → verify preload method → leak/functional check
service_qualification.note: 50 cycles is a conservative project qualification target until product service-life/maintenance-cycle requirement is formally frozen.

open_actions: approve service-cycle count and run qualification
